summary: Only 1921 newspaper notices of a planned steel fire tower near L'Anse (65 ft, later 70 ft on Froberg Hill); no completion or fate found. Summit is a hiking trail today.

access.note: A trip report describes a marked hiking trail that starts from a dead-end dirt parking area on Golf Course Road.

visit.trail_note: Drive south out of L'Anse on US-41 about 3 miles to Golf Course Road, follow it west to the dead-end dirt parking area, then walk about 10 minutes up the marked trail to the summit.

events.note: January 1921: a state district forest fire warden inspected Little Mountain as a fire tower site. A 65-foot steel tower was planned, to be erected on Froberg Hill, Baraga Township.
May 1921: a seventy-foot fire tower was reported being erected on Froberg Hill by the public domain commission. Completion is not reported.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The January 1921 notice gives 65 feet and the May 1921 notice gives 70 feet. The sources do not settle which, so no height is shown.
The January notice inspects Little Mountain, then says the tower is to go on Froberg Hill. The May notice places it on Froberg Hill. Left open.

notes_for_editor: Record fields checked: county Baraga is supported; status and access were unknown and are now set. Only 1921 newspaper notices (quoted on a compiler site) and one undated trip report. The notices conflict on height (65 vs 70 ft) and on site (Little Mountain vs Froberg Hill), so no height is set. The weebly index has a separate Froberg Hill page but no data record exists for it. No completion, staffing or removal evidence found. Status left unknown.
